source: 25. How should permissions be enforced in ZXNAME0000XZ so that unauthorized documents never become model context? [Advanced - Security] Authorization must be a data-access boundary, not a natural-language instruction to the model. The system should determine the user’s effective permissions and restrict candidate documents before unauthorized content is assembled into model context. Depending on the architecture, that can mean permission-aware filtering in the search layer, querying source systems under the caller’s identity, or post-retrieval authorization before prompt construction - but never relying on the ZXNAME0001XZ to ’ignore’ a document it was not allowed to see. Permissions must also propagate to cached results, summaries, graph nodes, and derived indexes. Recent enterprise access-control research argues for deterministic enforcement at both retrieval and generation boundaries because prompt sanitization and output filtering are probabilistic safeguards, not substitutes for authorization. Log which protected objects influenced each answer so access decisions are auditable. [30]
zh: 25. 如何在 ZXNAME0000XZ 中强制执行权限，以使未经授权的文档永远不会成为模型上下文？ [高级 - 安全性] 授权必须是数据访问边界，而不是模型的自然语言指令。在将未经授权的内容组装到模型上下文中之前，系统应确定用户的有效权限并限制候选文档。根据架构的不同，这可能意味着搜索层中的权限感知过滤、以调用者身份查询源系统，或者在提示构建之前进行检索后授权 - 但绝不依赖 ZXNAME0001XZ 来“忽略”不允许其查看的文档。权限还必须传播到缓存的结果、摘要、图形节点和派生索引。最近的企业访问控制研究主张在检索和生成边界上执行确定性执行，因为及时清理和输出过滤是概率性保障措施，而不是授权的替代品。记录哪些受保护对象影响每个答案，以便访问决策可审核。 [30]
